selectedEvidence: Used by examples/demo-site (this site) and examples/node-ssr-demo as reference consumers.
Emits a .portfolio-engine/manifest.json on every build with active route registry, override surfaces, and a design-token snapshot.
Ships a `portfolio-engine` CLI (alias: `pnpm pe:doctor`) that inspects the manifest and reports route origins, override status, and theme version.
CI guards the no-public/-in-engine-packages rule on every commit so theme packages stay code-only.
Three route-ownership modes — theme routes, consumer-local registry routes, and ordinary src/pages — all coexist in this same demo.

items: Astro 6 integration API

IframeEmbed with HTTPS-only validation and host allowlist

Content inventory + save via the GitHub Contents API

VS Code task wiring
Seed templates for CLAUDE.md, copilot-instructions.md, and .cursor/mcp.example.json

experience.title: v0.6 — Override surfaces, consumer registry, design snapshot
experience.description: Editorial-theme 0.6.0 + admin-tools 0.0.19. Locks in the public surface area for downstream consumers.
highlights: Five named override surfaces (Hero, FeaturedWriting, TestimonialSection, CollaborationSection, Footer) with stable prop contracts.
Consumer-local registry routes via src/pages-local/ + portfolio-engine.registry.json.
Design-token snapshot emitted to .portfolio-engine/design-snapshot.json for admin tooling.
Style overrides via overrides.styles, appended after the theme's global.css.

experience.title: v0.5 — Admin tools and schema extraction

highlights: @portfolio-engine/schema published as a pure Zod, framework-free package.
GitHub OAuth + Contents-API writes; devBypass mode for local development.

experience.title: v0.3 — Engine-core integration
experience.description: The Astro integration that brokers config, content, and route injection. The first 'engine' worth the name.
highlights: Vite virtual modules for config, context, routes, and overrides.
JSON-config loader bridged to Zod schemas with friendly error reporting.
Route discovery + injection replacing every banned third-party theme helper.

experience.title: v0.1 — Foundations
experience.description: Initial Zod schemas, layered architecture sketched in docs/architecture/, banned-dependencies policy recorded.
highlights: Four-layer architecture (schema → engine-core → editorial-theme → consumer) committed in docs/architecture/README.md.
Banned-dependencies list captured: astro-theme-provider, astro-pages, astro-public.
First Astro theme built strictly first-party, no generic abstractions.

education.note: Turborepo monorepo patterns and consumer-app separation.
Token-driven design via CSS custom properties.

awards.title: Discipline: no packaged public/ in engine packages
awards.description: Engine packages ship code, not assets. Every commit runs a check; the consumer's public/ directory is the single source of truth for static files.

awards.title: Discipline: layers only depend downward
awards.description: schema → engine-core → editorial-theme → consumer. Upward dependencies are rejected at review time. Keeps upgrades obvious and breaking changes loud.

awards.title: Discipline: banned dependencies are stated, not implied
awards.description: astro-theme-provider, astro-pages, astro-public — these are explicitly listed as off-limits with reasoning. Route injection and virtual modules are first-party.

awards.title: Discipline: friendly Zod errors at build time
awards.description: Misconfigured site.json or theme.json produces a precise, path-pointing error from @portfolio-engine/schema rather than a stack trace from inside Astro.
